interpretation: Thirty-second rehearsal passes unchanged smoke gates. Fifteen-minute run completes all3600writes and correctness checks but fails acknowledgementp95; retain its nonzero exit and all samples.
Continuous observations use one different actor on the opposite logical node. Two APIs share one coordinator; no independent-host/all-to-all/deployed capacity claim.

Successful stream openings prove repeated authorized HTTP200 opens, not their causes. Counts include reopens from timeout/unavailability as well as fixed lifetime; high reopen counts are not proof of clean lifetime-only renewal.

The long run records1233 opened and1201 unavailable stream events by its final measured resource sample; substantial transport churn is unresolved even though matching edits and successful reopen counts pass. Acknowledgementp95 rises across successive36-wave buckets from2155.2ms to3780.8ms; this association is not a proven production cause.
Numeric resource samples are thirty-second point observations, not continuous maxima or a memory-leak diagnosis. Pool waits and local latency do not establish a production cause.

The paused raw TCP consumer expires at its existing five-minute lifetime; the stalled acknowledgement metric reuses the same measured acknowledgement samples and is not independent full-window saturation proof.

Local fixture uses restricted PostgreSQL and real Valkey, substituted68byte image content/scanning, headless Chromium and nominal100ms browser shaping. It does not accept real media-at-capacity, physical devices, staging or independent review.
The rehearsal precedes addition of unchanged-budget HTTP aborts. The fifteen-minute run includes those aborts; compiled browser code and all product limits remain unchanged.

After measurement, explicit .mts lint moved a single-assignment observer-expiry timer declaration to const without changing timer scheduling or the workload. Raw source hashes identify the exact measured harness.
